newsitem.title: MEXICO: GMexico sees molybdenum output up slightly in 1996.
newsitem.headline: GMexico sees molybdenum output up slightly in 1996.

text.p: Grupo Mexico, the country's largest mining company known as GMexico, is set to slightly increase molybdenum output this year over the 3,806 tonnes of metal content in concentrates produced in 1995.

Deputy Finance Director Carlos Oyanguren told Reuters in an interview that GMexico, the only producer of molybdenum in Mexico, would slightly increase output this year because of natural richer seams being mined.
"Output will be a little more," he said, although not giving a specific figure. He explained as mining operations went deeper at GMexico's La Caridad mine, molybdenum deposits were richer.
--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com
